T: Learn the language. Then pass the plate.
D: A linguist is brought in to talk with the visitors inside a giant shell hovering over Montana.
P: Serve the snacks when Louise takes off her suit and steps up to the glass.
S: Logogram parmesan and black sesame crisps
the circular inky logograms the heptapods write

Parmesan and black sesame spooned into rings and baked into lacy crisps, each splattered with a little squid ink mayo like a heptapod logogram. Mix 150g finely grated parmesan with 2 tbsp black sesame seeds. Spoon into 16 thin rings about 8cm wide on baking paper, leaving the middles open. Bake at 190C for 6 minutes until golden and lacy, then cool on the tray to crisp. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tsp squid ink. Flick or pipe the black mayo around each crisp in a rough circle just before serving.
Chewy beef jerky marinated in soy, Worcestershire and garlic, oven dried
Beef topside sliced thin, marinated overnight in soy, Worcestershire, pepper and garlic, dried in the oven at 75C for 4 hours until chewy.
Crunchy sunflower, pepita, linseed and chia crackers with soft goat cheese
Sunflower, pumpkin, linseed and sesame seeds mixed with chia and water, spread thin, baked at 160C for an hour until crunchy, broken into shards with soft goat's cheese.
M: Beef chuck simmered 3 hours with chipotles, tomatoes and kidney beans

Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, tomato, cumin and chipotle until thick, ladled into bowls with cheddar, sour cream and cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add a can of crushed tomatoes, a spoon of cumin, 2 chopped chipotles and water to cover. Simmer for 3 hours until it falls apart, adding 2 cans of kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Ladle into bowls with grated cheddar.
Lake house dill salmon, new potatoes
the glass house by the lake

Salmon fillets roasted on lemon slices with dill and olive oil, with crushed new potatoes and a cucumber, crème fraîche and dill salad. Boil 800g new potatoes until tender, then crush lightly with butter and salt. Lay 2 sliced lemons in a tray, top with 4 salmon fillets, drizzle with olive oil and scatter with dill and salt. Roast at 200C for 12 minutes until just cooked. Slice 2 Lebanese cucumbers thinly and toss with 150g crème fraîche, chopped dill, a squeeze of lemon and salt. Serve together.
W: Ring-shaped meringue filled with whipped cream and blackberries
Meringue piped into a ring, baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, filled with whipped cream and blackberries, a drizzle of dark chocolate around the edge.
K: Strong Earl Grey with honey and lemon, served hot or over ice
Earl grey brewed strong, honey stirred through, a slice of lemon, served hot in big mugs or iced on a warm night.

The glass wall between the room and them

dishes.make_ahead: Dry within a day of marinating, keeps 1 week airtight

steps.text: Freeze the beef for an hour.
Slice very thin across the grain.
Mix the soy, Worcestershire, pepper and crushed garlic and coat the beef.
Marinate overnight.
Lay on racks over trays.
Dry in the oven at 75C until chewy.
Mix the seeds with the water.
Rest for 15 minutes.
Spread thin on a lined tray.
Bake at 160C until crunchy.
Break into shards and serve with goat's cheese.

dishes.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

Add the tomatoes, cumin, chipotles and water to cover.
Simmer until it falls apart.
Add the kidney beans for the last 30 minutes.
Ladle into bowls with cheddar.

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches until they lose their water.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, cumin, chipotles and stock.
Simmer until the sweet potato starts to break down and thicken the pot.
Add the kidney beans and simmer until thick.
Ladle into bowls with cheddar.

dishes.make_ahead: Meringue up to 2 days airtight, fill just before serving

steps.text: Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.
Pipe into a large ring on a lined tray.
Bake at 120C.
Cool in the oven.
Whip the cream and melt the chocolate.
Fill with cream and blackberries and drizzle chocolate around the edge.
Brew the tea bags in freshly boiled water until strong.
Stir in honey to taste.
Add a slice of lemon to each cup.
Serve hot in big mugs, or chill and pour over ice.

s.note: Chewy beef jerky marinated in soy, Worcestershire and garlic, oven dried
s.how: Freeze 800g beef topside for an hour, then slice very thin across the grain. Marinate overnight in soy sauce, Worcestershire, cracked pepper and crushed garlic. Lay on racks over trays and dry in the oven at 75C for 4 hours until chewy.

s.note: Crunchy sunflower, pepita, linseed and chia crackers with soft goat cheese
s.how: Mix 60g each of sunflower seeds, pepitas, linseeds and sesame seeds with 40g chia and 250ml water. Rest 15 minutes, spread thin on a lined tray and bake at 160C for an hour until crunchy. Break into shards and serve with soft goat's cheese.

m.note: Beef chuck simmered 3 hours with chipotles, tomatoes and kidney beans
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add a can of crushed tomatoes, a spoon of cumin, 2 chopped chipotles and water to cover. Simmer for 3 hours until it falls apart, adding 2 cans of kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Ladle into bowls with grated cheddar.

w.note: Ring-shaped meringue filled with whipped cream and blackberries
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Pipe into a large ring and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Fill with whipped cream and blackberries and drizzle melted dark chocolate around the edge.

d.note: Strong Earl Grey with honey and lemon, served hot or over ice
d.how: Brew 4 earl grey tea bags in a litre of freshly boiled water for 5 minutes until strong. Stir in honey to taste and add a slice of lemon to each cup. Serve hot in big mugs, or chill and pour over ice on a warm night.
